summary: The app is an interactive, procedurally generated 3D video game that lets users explore a full model of San Francisco in a web browser. It runs entirely client‑side and offers an API/SDK/webhook for integration, though it is not distributed via PyPI. It is suited for educators, urban planners, or hobbyists who want an immersive city‑exploration experience. Its standout strength is a faster load time than comparable CesiumJS demos (load ratio 0.720), while the main caveat is occasional performance and compatibility issues noted by users.
